findings.rationale: The aws_iam_role.admin trust policy broadly permits role assumption while aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin grants AdministratorAccess, exposing an unrestricted privileged escalation path.
The aws_iam_policy.assume_broadly Statement[0] grants sts:AssumeRole without constraining Resource, allowing holders to assume arbitrary roles.
The aws_iam_role.external_trust trust policy names an external AWS account as Principal, creating an identity-boundary bypass for role assumption.

findings.control: identity boundary: MFA condition on sensitive trust
findings.rationale: The aws_iam_role.external_trust Statement[0] has no Condition block, so the external principal can assume the role without an MFA check.
